title: Terrava
headline: Every run claims new ground
summary: A running app where every run expands your territory, builds personalized heatmaps, and rewards consistency with streaks and milestones.
cover_alt: Terrava cover: a phone showing a glowing territory map, beside the line Every run expands your territory.
cover_caption: Terrava cover: the territory map on a phone.

story.heading: Overview
story.body: TERRAVA is a next-generation running experience that transforms every run into a living, evolving world. Instead of focusing solely on fitness statistics, TERRAVA rewards movement through territory expansion, heatmaps, achievements, streaks, and cinematic replay experiences.

story.heading: The goal
story.body: The goal was to create a product that motivates users not just to run farther, but to explore new places, build consistency, and share meaningful accomplishments with others.

story.alt: Terrava project overview: a phone showing the territory map, with the project name, designed by Interface Lab, published June 2026, in mobile app design, fitness and gamified running.
story.caption: Project overview.

story.alt: Terrava user flow: get started, login and sign up lead to home, territory, heatmap, report, start run, achievements and profile.
story.caption: User flow.
